name: Urfé
terms: Indication Géographique Protégée, the tier below AOC. It replaced vin de pays in 2009.

blurb.text: An IGP in the Loire department. Parts of it overlap the Côte Roannaise and Côtes du Forez appellations, which are for dry red and rosé wines from Gamay.
